Dr. Vahid and his team deliver durable, natural-looking results that improve both oral health and quality of life.

treatmentJourney.title: Initial Consultation & Planning
treatmentJourney.description: Your journey begins with a comprehensive exam, 3D scans, and a detailed discussion of your goals to create a personalized implant treatment plan.

treatmentJourney.title: Preparation & Foundation Work
treatmentJourney.description: Any necessary preliminary treatments like extractions, bone grafting, or gum care are performed to ensure a strong foundation for your implants.

treatmentJourney.title: Precise Implant Placement
treatmentJourney.description: The titanium implant post is surgically placed into your jawbone with precision, providing a stable anchor for your new tooth.

treatmentJourney.title: Healing & Osseointegration
treatmentJourney.description: Over several months, the implant naturally fuses with your jawbone, creating a strong and permanent bond vital for long-term stability.

treatmentJourney.title: Abutment & Impressions
treatmentJourney.description: Once healing is complete, an abutment is placed on the implant, and final impressions are taken to custom-craft your permanent crown or bridge.

treatmentJourney.title: Permanent Restoration & Care
treatmentJourney.description: Your custom-made crown, bridge, or arch is securely attached, and we provide guidance for long-term care to ensure your new smile lasts for years.

faqItems.question: How do dental implants work to replace missing teeth?
faqItems.answer: Dental implants are titanium posts surgically placed into the jawbone to act as artificial tooth roots. These posts fuse with the bone, providing a stable foundation for crowns, bridges, or full arches that look and function like natural teeth.

faqItems.question: Am I a good candidate for dental implants?
faqItems.answer: Most adults with missing or failing teeth are candidates for dental implants. Dr. Vahid will assess your oral health, including bone density, during an initial consultation to determine the best treatment plan for you, even if you have bone loss.

faqItems.question: How long does the dental implant process take from start to finish?
faqItems.answer: The entire dental implant process typically spans several months. This includes initial consultation and planning, surgical placement, a healing period for osseointegration, and finally, the placement of your permanent restoration.

faqItems.question: What are my options if I am missing several teeth?
faqItems.answer: If you are missing several teeth, we offer solutions like implant bridges or full arch restorations. Implant bridges can replace multiple adjacent teeth, while full arch options restore an entire set of teeth with just a few implants.

faqItems.question: What financial options are available for dental implants?
faqItems.answer: We offer an in-house dental discount plan, accept various dental insurances, and can assist with third-party financing to make your dental implant treatment affordable and accessible.

faqItems.question: Is the dental implant procedure painful?
faqItems.answer: Patient comfort is a top priority. We utilize effective local anesthesia during the surgical placement of implants, and sedation options are available to ensure a comfortable and stress-free experience.

doctor.name: Dr. Arash Vahid
doctor.bio: Dr. Vahid has nearly 20 years of experience in the dental field, having grown up around dentistry with both parents being dentists. He was drawn to the profession from a young age, inspired by its ability to calm fears and transform lives. Dr. Vahid is dedicated to continuous education, focusing on dental implants, cosmetic procedures, and restorative dentistry to provide high-quality care that uplifts patients as a whole. He strives for excellence in clinical care while fostering a fun and relaxed office environment.
